fact: An explainer issued in October 2023 under the names of the Ministry of Interior and CDS Limited (شركة سي دي أس المحدودة) presents the Sudan police electronic reporting system at sudanpolice.net as set up by the police presidency through that company after the war began on 15 April 2023: a citizen opens a report of a missing person, sexual violence, stolen property or a stolen vehicle online, the system generates the report number, and the citizen can then look up the report's status and the steps taken with that number and a phone number.
